snippet.title: Sound System | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Official Early Access Launch Trailer for Sound System on PC Steam!

Buy the game here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4242730/Sound_System/

Play the songs you love, including the ones you wrote. Sound System is a rock rhythm game for guitar, bass, and drums, with a built-in chart editor that turns any track into a playable chart. Chase gold in Pro Mode or just jam in Classic. If you can hear it, you can play it.

SOUND SYSTEM SOCIALS
►Twitter: https://x.com/SoundSysGame
►Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/playsoundsystem/
►TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@playsoundsystem
